_comment: Per-clip metadata (clip name = FBX file stem, or 'file:take'). Keys: loop, speed, root_motion (host applies root travel; default off = in place), markers [left_plant, right_plant] (normalized foot plant phases; auto-detected when omitted), events [{time, type: footstep_l|footstep_r|weapon_fire|<custom>}], blend_in, blend_out, additive, reference (clip used as the additive reference pose).
